about.heading: Sujay Hawaldar
about.body:
Welcome to ShotsAndStories!

Where moments are captured in their purest, unscripted form.

 
At ShotsAndStories, we specialise in capturing the raw emotions, from the tender moments shared during a ceremony to the joyous celebrations on the dance floor; fleeting glances, and spontaneous interactions that make each moment unique. From the laughter shared between friends to the quiet contemplation of an individual lost in thought, we believe that every shot tells a story.

 
Our teams of experienced photographers work closely with you to understand your vision and bring it to life. A keen eye for detail and a passion for storytelling. Whether it's a Wedding, a Birthday party, a Baby bump, a Family gathering; we strive to document the essence of each moment with authenticity and artistry.

 
Browse through our portfolio to see our work, and imagine the possibilities for your special day. Your event deserves to be told, and we're honored to be a part of it.

 
Reach out to us to schedule a consultation, and let us help you create memories that will last a lifetime.
